repositories.emptyDisabled: No repositories are excluded from scans.
repositories.disableConfirmBody:
"{name}" will no longer be scanned for worktrees.

Nothing is deleted: its {count} worktree(s) and their chat history, tasks and verification runs stay in the database, and any tmux session running under it keeps running.

Its worktrees also stay in the sidebar — use the Visibility toggle to hide them.

Its role defaults stay too, and apply again when it is scanned again.
repositories.duplicateScanRootWarning: Same git repository as an existing scan root: {paths}. Both will be scanned, and every worktree they share will be registered twice.
repositories.duplicateConfirmTitle: Register a second scan root for the same repository?
repositories.duplicateConfirmBody:
"{path}" is the same git repository as:
{paths}

Both roots list the same worktrees, so every sync registers each of them twice and their "repository path" flips between the roots run to run.

This is allowed — continue if you want to manage these worktrees as separate roots. Otherwise cancel, or use the Scan toggle on the Repositories list to exclude one of them later.
repositories.duplicateRowDetail: Same git repository as {paths}. Use the Scan toggle on one of these rows to exclude it from scans.
repositories.rolesKeptNote: An excluded repository keeps its role defaults, and uses them again when it is scanned again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.pageDescription: Defaults for new branches, notifications, external apps, and more.

defaultSurfaceMode.title: Default output surface
defaultSurfaceMode.description: Which surface a session's output half opens in: the live terminal, or the conversation transcript. You can still switch either way from the session header.
defaultSurfaceMode.appliesToNew: Only affects surfaces you have not switched yet. A split or phone tab you already toggled keeps the mode you left it in.

hint.terminal: The agent's terminal, exactly as it is drawn in tmux.
hint.chat: The conversation transcript, as a message list.

defaultAgents.title: Default agents for new branches
defaultAgents.description: The agents a newly discovered branch opens with, in order. The first one is the primary — the tab that opens first and the default target for sends.
defaultAgents.appliesToNew: Existing branches are left alone. Their tabs stay exactly as they are.
defaultAgents.opencodeSharedData: OpenCode and OpenCode V2 are both installed. They share ~/.local/share/opencode, and V2 changes the database in ways OpenCode 1.x cannot read — if OpenCode fails to start, use OpenCode V2 only or give OpenCode 1.x its own data directory.

agentRoles.title: Roles
agentRoles.loadError: Could not read the role information.
agentRoles.description: A role is the instructions given to a session when it starts. Write a body per role, then use it as a per-tool default or on one session. It resolves session → repository → system. Changing a setting does not reach a running session until its next start.
agentRoles.personaNote: OpenCode's persona (build, plan, …) is not a role. A persona is the agent you switch inside OpenCode; a role is instructions CommandMate gives at startup.
agentRoles.replacesDefaultNote: On OpenCode V2 a role replaces the agent's default instructions rather than adding to them.
agentRoles.resumedAcrossRoleNote: This start continued an earlier conversation, so replies from another role are still in its history. A new conversation can be started at the next start.
agentRoles.adapterDisabledNote: Applying a role to this tool is not enabled yet. A start that resolves to a role is refused.
agentRoles.unsupportedNote: Roles do not apply to this tool.

ambiguous.rootSettingsDiffer: Cannot tell: the repositories this branch belongs to hold different settings ({roots}). Starts are refused until the repositories agree or the session names a role.
ambiguous.membershipUndetermined: Cannot tell: git could not confirm which repository this belongs to ({roots}). Starts are refused until that is resolved or the session names a role.

agentRoles.savedStale: The latest state could not be read back after a change, so this may be out of date. Reload the page.
agentRoles.saveUnknown: Whether this was saved could not be confirmed. Check the current setting.

mem.loadError: Could not read the mem settings.
mem.description: Decide per branch whether mem is used: the branch override, then the rules (the first that matches from the top), then off. Off by default.
mem.limits: Only this screen changes the mode. A process with the same OS rights (agents included) can still write the database or the API directly; that is not prevented.

status.conflict: Changed elsewhere. The latest settings are shown; save again.
status.invalid: Some values cannot be stored (check the patterns and branch names).

decisions.open: Record decisions in their canonical place
decisions.title: Recording decisions ({branch})
decisions.description: A person checks the diff and records a decision left in mem as an Issue comment or in a document of a worktree. Nothing is written until you press "Approve and write". CommandMate never commits or pushes.
decisions.limits: What this cannot stop: a process running with the same OS rights can fake the screen's mark and write the database directly. Agents do not approve because the CLI has no way to and the skills say so, not because it is guaranteed.
decisions.noWorktree: No worktree is on this branch
decisions.none: No decision is waiting to be recorded
decisions.modeNotOn: mem is not on for this branch ({mode}). Approving and recording need on.
decisions.unreflected: Not reflected: recorded as a comment only, not yet reflected in the canonical place (such as the Issue body)

effect.label: Effect
effect.spec: Changes the specification (recorded, waiting for reflection, once written)
effect.record_only: Record only (the specification does not change)

decisions.quoteConfirmed: I checked the quote against the original
decisions.invisible: Invisible characters were replaced with [U+XXXX] (also in the branch or the author; a branch is written in its omitted form)
decisions.confirmReflected: I checked it is reflected in the canonical place
decisions.abandon: I checked it is not there
decisions.acknowledgeDiff: I checked the item changed after it was written

operation.unknown: Outcome unknown: never sent again by itself. Reconcile it
operation.abandoned: Checked as not there (treated as not sent)

decisions.unresolved: Operations still unsettled after their item was closed or deleted
decisions.pending: Written, but the item did not move ({reason})
decisions.concurrent: Something else changed the document while writing. Check the document
decisions.reapproval: Changed since the approval ({reason}). Make the diff again
